featured_reviews.name: Rohini Khedekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We gave them Parcel of 23kgs to be sent to Boston.

Neelam and the other Sir who packed our stuff, both were professional.

We went there for packing the stuff at Thursday and the parcel was received in Boston, USA, the next Thursday.

The price we paid was worth it, as the parcel was sent in due time, and the parcel was in its best condition on recieval.

Suggestions- If you are going to send something heavy, it's better if you insist on being present while they pack your stuff, like ask them to pack your stuff in front of you, so that you can know which stuff to place where, for example we had amongst other items, Papad, which we told them to place them at the last so as to prevent their crumbling.

If you are sending your package overseas and if you have a heavy package, I will suggest you to categorize your items, and note their numbers. For eg we had sent clothes , so they 1st categorized the clothes into T-shirts, Shirts, jackets and so on and then counted each one of them. Then there were food items, each food item was counted and categorized, for eg sweets, snacks, spices, biscuits, mouth freshner etc.

The weight is taken as a round figure, for example if your packages weight is 7.3 it will be counted as 8 kgs.

Overall it cost us 23K for 23kgs (including the box)

We are happy with their service. Would consider sending more frequently.

featured_reviews.review_text:
SCAM ALERT – FRAUDULENT & DISHONEST COURIER

Sonali Courier is a complete scam. Do NOT trust them with anything valuable unless you’re ready to lose your money, your belongings, and your peace of mind.

We paid ₹96,000 for AIR delivery from Mumbai to Dubai (door-to-door). Our shipment had important documents, expensive clothes, shoes, and our 6-year-old child’s toys—things he is emotionally attached to.

First scam: the packer sent by Sonali Courier illegally charged ₹12,000 extra. When we complained, the company casually said the guy “ran away to his village” and took zero responsibility. Absolute joke.

Second scam: despite charging for air cargo, they secretly sent our shipment by SEA without consent. After that, it was nonstop lies for weeks:
“It will arrive this week”
“It’s in customs”
“It’s not in Dubai”
“It’s stuck in Dubai”

Every call came with a new excuse. No honesty. No accountability.

Then it got worse. We were threatened and pressured to pay 400 AED to someone in Dubai who is holding our boxes hostage and refusing to release them.

Weeks later, our parcel is still not delivered.
Because of their fraud and harassment, we were forced to file police complaints in both India and the UAE.

This company caused financial loss, extreme stress, and emotional trauma to our family. Their behavior is unprofessional, unethical, and borderline criminal.

Avoid Sonali Courier at all costs. If you value your money or belongings, stay far away

SCAM FRAUD
Extremely disappointing and distressing experience with Sonali Courier.

We paid ₹92,000 for air delivery from Mumbai to Dubai (door-to-door). The shipment included important documents, valuable clothes and shoes, and our 6-year-old child’s toys, which he is very emotionally attached to.

First, the person sent by Sonali Courier to pack our items charged an extra ₹12,000, which later turned out to be a scam. When we reported this to the company, we were told that the person had “run away to his village,” and no responsibility was taken.

Despite paying for air cargo, our shipment was sent by sea without our consent. For weeks, we were continuously lied to and misled with changing explanations:
•	“It will arrive this week”
•	“It’s in customs”
•	“It’s not in Dubai yet”
•	“It’s stuck in Dubai”

Each time, the story changed.

We were forced to coordinate with Sonali Courier in India and their contacts in Dubai, yet nothing was resolved. On top of this, we were threatened and pressured to pay an additional 400 AED to someone in Dubai who has our boxes and is refusing to release them.

It has now been weeks, and our parcel is still not delivered. Due to the seriousness of the situation, we had to file police complaints in both India and the UAE.

This experience has caused immense stress, financial loss, and emotional distress to our family. I would strongly advise others to avoid this courier service, especially for valuable or important shipments.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Universal Courier,Andheri (East). MASSIVE SCAM AND FRAUD!!
This courier service is a massive scam and absolute fraud!! These people are money hungry and will always profit off from the customers. I had sent parcel to  my son to USA through this courier service for the  very first time.  The agents completely lied about the duration of courier delivery and cost of the parcel , instead of courier reaching within 8 days, this parcel took 20 days to reach to USA and got stuck in USA customs due to suspicion of package in warehouse. As we were tracking this courier , the whole route of this courier was via different states and country  which took  very long route therefore it lead to suspicion of package by USA customs.  When  finally  delivered to the address after 20 days my son was asked to pay for  import C.O.D
charges because this  main universal courier agent failed to complete the formality process in India ,said by delivery guy in USA ,therefore my son  had to pay  extras money additional to the original amount we paid.
The delivery boy (biggest cheater and fraud) who took initiative for our courier; he also lied about leakage in parcel (there were no liquid items at all) and further gave false reasons about why my courier was stuck in USA customs.
The delivery boy made the list of items in the courier and kept the copy of it with himself and did not give that copy of same list to me therefore  when time comes  ,he misuses it to manipulate the customers.
So all the customers here please be aware of this fraud delivery boy and the cheater fraud service by this staff of Universal Courier Agency in Andheri(East).
Please be ALERT OR CHOOSE ANOTHER TRUSTWORTHY AGENCY so that you can send your package to USA in safest way ,  without any extra expenses and stress free.

featured_reviews.name: Ambience Decor
featured_reviews.review_text:
Booked a courier through Blue Dart yesterday from Panipat to Mumbai.
The package reached Andheri (West) branch today morning around 8:56 AM.

When I called the branch to check the delivery status, I was informed that the material had not arrived. However, the online tracking clearly showed that the shipment had already reached the location. This clearly reflects poor coordination and misinformation given to customers.

After multiple follow-ups, they finally admitted that the parcel had arrived and told me to personally visit the branch for collection.

When I insisted that it's their responsibility to deliver the shipment—especially since it was sent by air due to an urgent requirement—they said delivery would only happen on Monday , which is completely unacceptable.

I visited the branch myself at 5 PM, but they still refused to hand over the parcel, demanding additional proof.

No proper contact numbers or email IDs were shared.
Overall, extremely unprofessional and disappointing service from Blue Dart. I will not be recommending their service to anyone going forward.
